api.credit_config(cfg=None): Validate/resolve metric, direction, wm_samples, sumo_verify_fraction, verify_mode and isolated; reject unknown keys and invalid/nonfinite values.
api.assert_observable(payload, patterns=None: Reject truth-shaped keys recursively in mappings, sequences and dataclass moves. Callers remain responsible for own-sensing/V2V provenance.
api.wm_estimate(scorer, belief, members, mov: Score full-group team delay on base, joint, each member solo and each member-reverted scenario. Returns outcome, credit, isolated diagnostics, members, move, draw_id, full horizon and WM sample seeds.
api.scorer(belief, intervention, rng_child): Injected belief-only CPU WM scorer returning finite team delay. Intervention includes kind, active_members, group_members, background='base_mappo', horizon_s, optional member and move. Only active observable CAV members receive the move; all others remain base MAPPO and HDVs are never commanded. Score the SAME full group/window for every intervention.
api.layer_advantage(estimate, cfg=None): Return members, per_member and team. The identical group advantage is broadcast to each member; use it instead of per-CAV advantages in the cooperation-layer loss only.
api.verify_requests(estimates, rng, cfg=None: Bernoulli selection at sumo_verify_fraction, independent of predicted benefit; emit detached dry all8/isolated requests, preserving draw_id, full horizon and WM sample seeds. Does not dispatch or reserve anything.
api.verification_candidates(request, plan, s: Dry adapter producing ordinary feasible-plan subset candidates, existing sumo_verify.build_branches specs, and branch_indices for base/joint/alone/reverted. Preserves full profiles and windows, deduplicates equal masks, rejects active background cooperation and mismatched full horizons. Does not execute verification.
api.verified_stats(records): Offline-only WM/exact D_G sign agreement, tie count and MAE. Expects records with wm.D_G and exact.D_G; rejects empty or nonfinite data. Exact outcomes are not inputs to layer_advantage.

semantics.group_reward: utility_with_move - utility_without_move, with utility = -team_delay; group_credit = D_G = base_delay - joint_delay, positive for improvement
semantics.raw_delay_delta: credit.delay_delta = joint_delay - base_delay; improvement aliases positive-benefit group_credit
semantics.member_reversion: D_i[i] = reverted_i_delay - joint_delay; C_G = D_G - sum(D_i), via the existing credit.algebra function
semantics.isolated_synergy: policy_cooperation_gain_veh_s = best_solo_delay - joint_delay, matching policy_synergy.metrics; solo gains are base_delay - solo_delay
semantics.layer_only: per_member = [group_credit] * group_size. D_i/C_G and isolated synergy are diagnostics, not a hand-weighted replacement reward. Base MAPPO rewards, parameters and optimizers are not passed into or mutated by this module.
semantics.pairing: Each WM sample draws one seed; every scenario starts a fresh generator at that SAME seed and receives isolated input copies. Distinct samples have distinct RNG draws. No advancing shared child stream between counterfactuals.
semantics.group_contract: 1..4 unique observable CAV string ids, preserving member order; move.members, when present, must match the counterfactual group
semantics.horizon: Scorer owns the unchanged full registered look-ahead. Explicit horizon_s is forwarded unchanged to all WM branches and verification requests; the dry adapter requires an equal exact window. With horizon_s=None the scorer owns its registered horizon and no explicit horizon equality assertion is possible.

configuration_note: Defaults preserve the resumed implementation's declared registration. The run registration should bind wm_samples, verification fraction and full horizon identically for B/R; this CPU build does not create or amend a run registration.
integration: T2C/T2D explicitly opt in: inject the full-horizon belief-only WM scorer into wm_estimate, then pass layer_advantage(...).per_member to the cooperation-layer PPO loss, replacing its per-CAV advantage signal. Keep the base MAPPO frozen.

Use verify_requests with a dedicated reproducible selection RNG and the same fraction for B/R. Persist/claim selected draw_ids through existing orchestration to avoid duplicate verification after restart; this pure module creates no jobs or durable claims.

Convert the selected move to its ordinary feasibility-clamped plan. Call verification_candidates(request, plan, frozen_base_snapshot) to get candidates and branch_indices. It refuses a mismatched full horizon instead of changing the plan or shortening the look-ahead.

Execution later uses existing sumo_verify.verify(snapshot, bundle.candidates, existing_runner, existing_charge, ...) followed by verify_perseed.confirm_all8(..., candidates=bundle.candidates, ...), retaining existing root/arm/phase, budget, health, claims and receipt machinery. The solo/reversion masks isolate the group from base-policy background, matching the isolated diagnostic decomposition.

For offline monitoring use branch_indices against each seed's completed verification outcomes: exact.D_G = J_policy_veh_s - J_candidates_veh_s[joint_index-1]. Reversions and solos use their own mapped branches; index 0 denotes the shared base. Never feed exact receipts or simulator snapshots back as WM/policy features.
